candidate_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (a:Feature)-[:disjointWith]->(b:Feature) WITH collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a IS NULL THEN null WHEN a.name < b.name THEN [a.name,b.name] ELSE [b.name,a.name] END) AS actualPairs WITH actualPairs, [["Conditional Handover (CHO, Rel-16)", "Conditional PSCell Addition/Change (CPAC, Rel-18)"], ["Conditional Handover (CHO, Rel-16)", "Conditional PSCell Change (CPC, Rel-16)"], ["Conditional Handover (CHO, Rel-16)", "LTM (L1/L2 Triggered Mobility, Rel-18)"], ["Conditional PSCell Addition/Change (CPAC, Rel-18)", "Conditional PSCell Change (CPC, Rel-16)"], ["Conditional PSCell Addition/Change (CPAC, Rel-18)", "LTM (L1/L2 Triggered Mobility, Rel-18)"], ["Conditional PSCell Change (CPC, Rel-16)", "LTM (L1/L2 Triggered Mobility, Rel-18)"]] AS expectedPairs RETURN coalesce(size(actualPairs) = size(expectedPairs) AND all(pair IN expectedPairs WHERE pair IN actualPairs), false) AS matchesCatalog
